summary: Phase 15b (P1): Sales tracking -> realized P&L. Backend: Item model gains sold/sold_at/sale_price; POST /api/items/{id}/mark-sold (sale_price >= 0, optional sold_at; 422 negative, 404 cross-workspace) and POST /api/items/{id}/mark-unsold (revert); ITEM_SOLD / ITEM_UNSOLD audit events. services/financials.py now splits the books: sold items use their actual sale price for REALIZED totals (realized_revenue, realized_fees, realized_tax, realized_net_profit, realized_margin_pct), open items stay POTENTIAL (potential_*), combined net_profit/net_margin_pct, per-row status + sale_price, per-category sold counts, and an updated note explaining realized vs potential. Frontend: ItemDetail Mark Sold flow (inline sale-price input, confirm, revert), ItemCard Sold chip, Financials page realized/potential stat cards + Status column. Verified with 4 new backend tests (full local suite 66 passed, 2 skipped) plus an esbuild syntax-check of every touched frontend file.
